question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant encountered when moving toward Proghorn Nature Area, Aurora, CO from Children's Hospital Colorado at Memorial Hospital, Colorado Springs, CO?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Children''s Hospital Colorado at Memorial Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Colorado Springs%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Proghorn Nature Area%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Aurora%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1) )::geography, 1000 -- 1000 meters buffer around the path ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Children''s Hospital Colorado at Memorial Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Colorado Springs%' LIMIT 1)::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
